description: An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.
transcript: This is your side, and this is my side, okay? Okay. Where am I supposed to put my clothes? Here, put them here.

en.question: What is the woman pointing at?
